spans.s: शिंशपा f. 1. Name of a tree called शिशु; 2. the Aśoka tree.
शिंघाण (I) m. 1. Phlegm; 2. froth, foam.
शिंघाण (II) n. 1. The mucus of the nose; 2. rust of iron; 3. a glass-vessel.
सिंघ(घा)ण n. 1. The mucus of the nose; 2. rust of iron.
सिंघ(घा)ण n. 1. The mucus of the nose; 2. rust of iron.
शिंघाणक (I) m.n. The mucus of the nose.
शिंघाणक (II) m. Phlegm.
शिंज m. Tinkle, jingle, especially of ornaments.
शिंजा f. 1. Tinkle, jingle, especially of ornaments; 2. a bowstring.
सिंजा f. The jingling sound of metallic ornaments.
शिंजंजिका f. A chain worn round the loins.
शिंजित (I) a. (f. ता) Tinkling.
शिंजित (II) n. The tinkling of an ornament, नेदं नूपुरशिंजितम् Vikr.iv., मंजुमंजीरशिंजितमनोहरमंबिकायाः K.Pr.x.
शिंजित (I) a. (f. ता) Tinkling.
सिंजित n. Tinkling, नेदं नूपुरसिंजितम् Vikr.iv.
शिंजिनी f. 1. A bowstring; 2. anklets worn round the feet.
शिनि m. Name of a warrior of the Yādava family.
सिनी f. A woman with a white complexion.
शिनेर्नप्तृ m. an epithet of Sātyaki.
शिंबा f. A pod, a legume.
शिंबिका f. 1. A pod, a legume; 2. a kind of kidney-bean.
शिंबी f. 1. A pod, a legume; 2. a kind of grass.
शीन (I) a. (f. ना) Thick, congealed.
शीन (II) m. 1. A block-head; 2. a large snake.
शीन (I) a. (f. ना) Thick, congealed.
सिन m. A morsel.

सिंह m. 1. A lion; (it is thus derived- भवेद्वर्णागमाद्धंसः सिंहो वर्णविपर्ययात्), ददर्श राजा जननीमिव स्वां गामग्रतः प्रस्राविणीं न सिंहम् R.ii.61; 2. the sign Leo of the zodiac.(As the last member of a compound, it means ‘preeminent.’)

सिंह-अवलोकनन्याय m. the maxim of the lion’s glance. It is used to denote the connection of a thing with the preceding and the following, just as the lion constantly pauses and casts his glance backward and forward.
सिंह-आसन (I) m. a kind of coitus.
सिंह-आसन (II) n. a throne.
सिंह-तल n. the two palms of the hands opened and placed side by side.
सिंह-तुंड m. a kind of fish.
सिंह-दर्प a. proud as a lion.
सिंह-द्वार n. a principal or chief gate.
सिंह-ध्वनि, -नाद m. a war-cry.
सिंह-ध्वनि, -नाद m. a war-cry.
सिंह-लील m. a kind of sexual union.
सिंह-वाहन m. an epithet of Śiva.
सिंह-संहनन (I) a. as strong as a lion.
सिंह-संहनन (II) n. the killing of a lion.
सिंहल (I) n. 1. Tin; 2. brass; 3. bark, rind; 4. the island of Ceylon, स्नाता तिष्ठति सिण्हलेश्वरसुता S.D.iii.
सिंहल (II) m. pl. the people of Ceylon.
सिंहलक n. The island of Ceylon.
सिंहाण(न) n. 1. Rust of iron; 2. the mucus of the nose.
सिंहाण(न) n. 1. Rust of iron; 2. the mucus of the nose.
सिंहिका f. The mother of Rāhu.
सिंहिका-पुत्र, -सुत, -सूनु m. an epithet of Rāhu.
सिंहिका-पुत्र, -सुत, -सूनु m. an epithet of Rāhu.
सिंहिका-पुत्र, -सुत, -सूनु m. an epithet of Rāhu.
सिंही m. 1. A lioness; 2. name of the mother of Rāhu.
सिंघिणी f. The nose.
सिंचिता f. Long pepper.
सिनीवाली f. The day of new moon, (सा दृष्टेंदुः सिनीवाली सा नष्टेंदुकला कुहूः Am.i.4.9).
सिंदु(धु)क m. Name of a small tree.
सिंदु(धु)क m. Name of a small tree.
सिंदु(धु)क m. Name of a small tree.
सिंदु(धु)क m. Name of a small tree.
सिंदूर (I) m. A sort of tree.
सिंदूर (II) n. Red lead, विकचनवकुसुंभस्वच्छसिंदूरभासा Rt.i.24.
सिंदूरी f. 1. Red clothes; 2. the name of two plants.

सिंधु (I) m. 1. The Indus; 2. the ocean; 3. the country along the Indus; 4. name of a river in Mālava, Megh.i.29 (against Mall. who renders it by ‘a river in general’); 5. the juice that exudes from an elephant’s temples; 6. an elephant.
सिंधु (II) m. pl. The inhabitants of the Sindhu country.
सिंधु (III) f. A great river in general, तस्याः सिंधोः पृथुमपि तनुं दूरभावात्प्रवाहम् Megh.i.46.
सिंधु-उपल n. rock-salt.
सिंधु-ज (I) a. 1. river-born or sea-born; 2. born in the Sindhu country.
सिंधु-ज (II) n. rock-salt.
सिंधु-ज (III) m. the moon.
सिंधुर m. An elephant.
सिन्व् vt. 1P (pres. सिन्वति) To wet.
